introHtml: Heat transfer decoration gives you the flexibility to print detailed, full-color logos on onesies, bibs, and toddler tees without the stiffness of screen printing. The soft feel and vibrant results make this method ideal for baby gifts, hospital welcome kits, or corporate family-friendly events. Choose heat transfer when you need a smooth, comfortable finish that holds up to repeated washing.
